note: Fuerte's lines (CLAUDE.md 5.0.1, RF-33, D-206). L&D can edit them without touching code. `lines` are keyed by where Fuerte speaks; `events` are the generic moments of 5.0.1. Each has the state of the illustration and one or more variants: the app picks one per session so Fuerte does not repeat itself. Two sentences at most, no judgment, no product recommendations, no promises, no urgency. {{name}} and similar placeholders are filled by the app.
